title: Statistics - Lesson 2: Quartiles Practice
description: Practice ordering data, calculating Q1, Q2, and Q3, and interpreting quartiles.

questions.question: Which action should come first when finding quartiles for an ungrouped data set?
options: Order the data from least to greatest
Add all values and divide by the number of values
Choose the value that appears most often
questions.explanation: Quartiles are position measures, so the data must be ordered before the median and halves can be identified.

questions.question: For the ordered data 4, 7, 9, 12, 15, what is Q2? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: There are five values, so Q2 is the middle value, 9.

questions.question: For the ordered data 4, 7, 9, 12, 15, what is Q1 using this lesson's method?
questions.explanation: Exclude the median 9. The lower half is 4 and 7, so Q1 = (4 + 7) / 2 = 5.5.

questions.question: For the ordered data 3, 6, 8, 10, 14, 18, what is Q2? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: There are six values, so Q2 is the average of the two middle values: (8 + 10) / 2 = 9.

questions.question: For the ordered data 3, 6, 8, 10, 14, 18, which pair gives Q1 and Q3?
questions.explanation: The lower half is 3, 6, 8, so Q1 = 6. The upper half is 10, 14, 18, so Q3 = 14.

questions.question: Q3 is always the same as the maximum value of the data set.
questions.explanation: Q3 is the third quartile, located around the 75% position. The maximum is the largest value.

questions.question: In one sentence, interpret this result for quiz scores: Q1 = 12.
questions.correctAnswer: About one-fourth of the quiz scores are at or below 12.
questions.explanation: A correct interpretation should connect Q1 to the lower quarter of the quiz score data.

questions.question: Why should the median be excluded from the halves when this lesson finds Q1 and Q3 for an odd number of data values?
questions.correctAnswer: Because the median is the middle of the whole data set, so this lesson uses only the values below it for Q1 and only the values above it for Q3.
questions.explanation: The convention keeps the lower and upper halves separate from the overall median.
